# GreenKube

GreenKube is an open-source Kubernetes project for cost visibility and estimated energy and carbon reporting. It is designed to be self-hosted. Workload carbon values are estimates, not direct physical measurements.

## Canonical website
- https://greenkube.cloud/

## Product pages
- [Product overview](https://greenkube.cloud/en/)
- [Carbon estimates and methodology](https://greenkube.cloud/en/carbon/)
- [Use cases](https://greenkube.cloud/en/use-cases/)
- [Optimization and verification method](https://greenkube.cloud/en/method/)
- [Community](https://greenkube.cloud/en/community/)
- [Optional services](https://greenkube.cloud/en/services/)

## Public resources
- [Technical documentation](https://docs.greenkube.cloud/)
- [Interactive demo](https://demo.greenkube.cloud/)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/GreenKubeCloud/GreenKube)
- [GitHub discussions](https://github.com/GreenKubeCloud/GreenKube/discussions)

GreenKube supports evidence-backed recommendations, GitOps pull requests for supported manifest changes, and post-change verification. Operators review and merge proposed changes. See the documentation for supported integrations, configuration, and carbon-estimation limitations.
